extracted.intended_audience: researchers, patent practitioners, historians, and librarians needing an alphabetical index of U.S. patents issued in 1878
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index of patentees for the year 1878 published by the United States Patent Office, listing patentee name, residence, invention title, issue date, patent number, monthly volume, and Official Gazette references. Intended as a historical/catalogue resource rather than guidance or evaluative criteria.
